description: The figure shows a bar chart intended to illustrate a set of categories related to fine-tuning design spaces, with multiple light green bars arranged along a slanted baseline and grouped near text labels including “Decreasing” and “Spindle” (with a partially visible label beginning “Bottlene…” further to the right). The category axis appears to run diagonally from left to right (rather than strictly horizontal), with category names placed along this diagonal; no explicit axis title is visible in the cropped image, and the ordering follows the left-to-right placement of the labeled groups. A numeric value axis is not visible in the crop: there are no tick marks, tick labels, units, or a clearly drawn vertical/horizontal axis line, so the scale type and value range cannot be read. Each bar is a pale/light green rectangle with a thin dark outline; within the “Decreasing” group, several adjacent bars step down in height from left to right (approximately five bars are visible), while near “Spindle” there are a few bars that rise higher than the nearby “Decreasing” bars (some extend beyond the top edge of the crop), and additional small bars appear near the far-left and far-right edges. There is no visible legend, no stacked segmentation within bars, and no explicit annotations or highlighting beyond the consistent color and outline styling.
